essence: Annapurna is revered as the essence of time units.
Annapurna is revered as the moon-crested great goddess.
Annapurna is revered as one who delights in Shiva's dance.
Annapurna is revered as the essence of Brahmani and other goddesses.
Annapurna is revered as the source of all bliss.
